bbd.text: Naiva, a young Temur hunter, climbs a sacred mountain with her twin sister Baishya, who says her vision has led them there, but an avalanche breaks across the Eternal Ice snowfield and buries them.
Baishya's hands glow green and she shapes the snow into a wall that holds, and Naiva later kills a goblin that ambushes her, then worries what she will do if their grandmother is dead.

The twins find the hunting party alive above the flood, but three of Atarka's broodlings soon land at the camp demanding the clan surrender its shamans, and Baishya explains that her vision came from Ugin and they must go to his grave.
On the way, Yasova sends Naiva and Baishya to scout a ring of stones, where Naiva disarms a wounded stranger who asks for Yasova Dragonclaw, and the twins insist their grandmother heal him.

m19.text: In Core Set 2019, Naiva and her grandmother Yasova kill an aven interpreter with spears when an Ojutai broodling threatens the wounded Tae Jin, and later Naiva kills a wounded Atarka broodling by driving her spear through its eye.
Naiva tells Tae Jin that Atarka killed their mother for being a whisperer, and his argument that keeping the old ways alive defies the dragons makes her realize she was wrong.

Yasova leads the twins to a hidden cavern, telling them they must become guardians of the carved memories of the ancestors, and Naiva follows Baishya into the hedron even while a whisper tempts her to abandon her twin.

Outside, Naiva calls out a false Mevra, who reveals herself as the dragon Nicol Bolas, and Bolas tries to turn her against Baishya and bring him Yasova, so that for a moment Naiva holds a knife to her sister's throat.
She snaps out of it as the hedron's essence reaches her, and when Bolas orders her to kill Yasova she resists, emerging to find the dragon gone and her grandmother and sister alive.
